messages:
eric: quick sync — SOC audit in ~4 weeks. we still have coverage gaps across api-gateway, auth, console, billing, runtime. need to triage and assign owners. main asks: schema changes for v2 audit events, KMS fields for customer evidence, and a customer-facing validation harness.

sophia: i'll take api-gateway. current gaps: LB-level logs missing consistent `request_id` and `caller.identity`. gateway adds proxy-level events but fields are inconsistent across cloud regions. also missing `event_type` standardization.

devon: i'll own auth. big gap: RBAC changes (grant/revoke) are not emitted from our auth service yet. failures on token exchange sometimes only show HTTP 401 with no reason. we need `outcome` and `failure_reason` on auth events. also we should attach `kms_action` for key-ops.

alex: console + billing here. console emits UI telemetry, but we don't surface admin actions (role edits, invite removals) as security audit events. billing: accesses to invoices and billing admin changes have zero audit entries currently — customer asks for proof of who viewed invoices.

pm-kate: prioritization suggestion: 1) role/grant changes (high) 2) auth failures w/ reason (high) 3) billing access records (medium-high) 4) gateway request_id consistency (medium) 5) runtime model exec logs that tie back to customer data access (medium, but sensitive).

eric: propose schema v2 minimal required fields so teams can implement uniformly: `event_id` (uuid), `event_ts` (iso8601), `actor.type`, `actor.id`, `action`, `resource.type`, `resource.id`, `outcome` (success|failure), `request_id`, `trace_id`, `metadata` (freeform). Also recommend `schema_version: v2` at top-level.

security-bot: +1 — suggested sample event attached by eric below.

eric: sample event for reference:

```json
{
  "schema_version": "v2",
  "event_id": "8a1f3d2e-6b4c-4a1b-b5d2-3f7e9a0c1d2e",
  "event_ts": "2026-03-18T15:02:21Z",
  "actor": {"type": "user", "id": "devon"},
  "action": "role.revoke",
  "resource": {"type": "team.role", "id": "infra-admin"},
  "outcome": "success",
  "request_id": "req_20260318_abc123",
  "trace_id": "trace-xyz-0001",
  "metadata": {"grant_source": "console", "old_role": "admin", "new_role": "none"},
  "kms": {"key_id": "projects/redwood/keys/rotation-2026-01", "action": "rotate", "envelope_id": "env-9876"}
}
```

sophia: approved — small ask: add `caller_ip` and `geo` when available, and normalize `actor.type` values (user|service|system). i'll add a unit test stub in gateway repo to assert presence.

devon: for RBAC events include `grant_source`, `admin_id` (who made the change), and `change_id` to tie to audit policy docs. also include a `before`/`after` snapshot in metadata when feasible. note: be careful with PII.

infra-paul: KMS integration notes: include `kms.key_id`, `kms.action`, `kms.envelope_id`, and `kms.result` (ok|error). we can emit a signed header from HSM but attaching signature blob to every event is heavy — suggest storing that in evidence store and referencing `evidence_id`.

alex: backlog triage plan (short): create epic `ENGSEC-LOGCOV-2026` and 5 issues: GATEWAY-reqid (owner sophia, 2d), AUTH-rbac-events (devon, 3d), CONSOLE-admin-audit (alex, 4d), BILLING-access-log (alex, 3d), RUNTIME-model-data-access (eric, 5d). estimate tot = 17d. propose ship-by end of sprint.

eric: action items: 1) owners create tickets in `audit-coverage` epic by EOD tomorrow 2) each ticket must include sample event (use schema v2) and test harness integration 3) infra to provide evidence store + `evidence_id` pattern (infra-paul) 4) security to draft customer-facing validation guide for audit events (pm-kate). i'll schedule a 30m deep-dive Tue 10am.

pm-kate: i'll start customer-facing validation doc. will include CLI to replay events and a checklist for customers: verify event_id, timestamps, actor, outcome, kms.evidence_id.

security-bot: created ticket ENGSEC-LOGCOV-2931 and assigned to leads.

eric: thanks all. ping me in thread when tickets exist and paste links. :thumbsup:
